metaDescription: Order custom red lanyards in bulk for your event or team. Perfect for ID badges, keys, and more at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Red lanyards make your team or event instantly recognizable. Whether you need 3/4" woven lanyards for a trade show or antimicrobial red lanyards for a healthcare setting, the bold color ensures high visibility. Pair them with a custom imprint using screen printing or dye sublimation for lasting brand exposure. Perfect for conferences, school IDs, or safety credentials.
